sentences.text:
OTHER PRESENT:
 SMT.PRIYA SHANAVAS, GOVT. PLEADER  THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 11.02.2020,

THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 W.P.(C) No.2326/2020 2  JUDGMENT Dated this the 11th day of February 2020
The petitioner moved the 1st respondent for assignment of Government land as per Ext.P4.
This was not considered for the reason that the petitioner had reclaimed the thodu vested in the Panchayath.

It is also stated that without hearing the local E.K.Sathar vs The Tahasildar on 11 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71579429/
1 authority, a decision cannot be taken.

Having considered the facts and circumstances, this Court is of the view that the application submitted by the petitioner shall be taken into logical conclusion within a period of four months,
after notice to the petitioner as well as the local authority.
This writ petition is disposed of as above.

Sd/-
A.MUHAMED MUSTAQUE JUDGE smp APPENDIX PETITIONER'S EXHIBITS:
EXHIBIT P1 TRUE COPY OF THE LICENSE ISSUED BY THE COMMISSIONERATE OF FOOD SAFETY, FOOD SAFETY AND STANDARDS AUTHORITY OF INDIA UNDER THE FSS ACT, 2006.
EXHIBIT P2 TRUE COPY OF THE LICENSE WITH RESPECT TO THE BUILDING SITUATED IN WARD NO.VIII BEARING NO.950C OF THRIKKAKKARA MUNICIPALITY FOR THE YEAR 2019-2020.
EXHIBIT P3 TRUE COPY OF REPLY GIVEN BY THE PUBLIC INFORMATION OFFICER ATTACHED TO THE THRIKKAKARA OFFICE OF THE KERALA STATE ELECTRICITY BOARD.
EXHIBIT P4 TRUE COPY OF APPLICATION PREFERRED BY THE PETITIONER BEFORE THE 1ST RESPONDENT DATED 25.08.1997.
EXHIBIT P5 TRUE COPY OF REPORT SUBMITTED BY THE REVENUE INSPECTOR RECOMMENDING TO ASSIGN THE PROPERTY IN FAVOUR OF THE PETITIONER.
RESPONDENTS' EXHIBITS: NIL.

True Copy P.S to Judge smp E.K.Sathar vs The Tahasildar on 11 February, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71579429/
